name: Sakagami Yukari
source:
Formerly known as Tooyama. The older sister who ended up marrying the protagonist. A composed beauty, she was quite popular but never dated anyone.

She spent her days honing her erotic skills “for her future husband Toshiya,” becoming an exceptionally skilled technician.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/okusama/chara.html]official site[/url]]
